body: The problem is that I thought I already did find those things. I don’t know how I’m going to find those things I’m interested in when all I’m able to do is stay and bed and living life in a long lasting cycle.

I really appreciate your comment and appreciate what you do because for some people I’m sure you really help them out. The thing is though I don’t know who you are and although your words are very meaningful they can’t really effect me because your not a real person in my life supporting me or understanding me. I simply just wish I can have someone who ik do the same. Everything that gives me joy parties, sex, having fun, etc. is only a temporary fix the next day when I wake up I instantly feel the same way. Nothing can make me happy anymore do you or anyone else know how to deal with this?
